tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from joint ventures are not acceptable
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejection.
All the formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner and shall be uploaded properly, signed by the tenderer
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
If any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Any change / extensions, etc. in the tender schedule (calendar of events) will not be published / advertised through newspapers changes will be updated on/in KPP Portal only
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP procurement portal

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR (GO:PWD 51 RDF 2019 Bangaluru Dt:18.03.2022). Therefore, amount put to Tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. KPPP-PORTAL format has No Options to add GST Separately at stage of Draft Tender Schedule Process for Over All amount put to Tender , tender has been inviting through an Option with INCLUSIVE. But the item wise rates do not include GST. Hence, contractor shall quote the rate excluding GST and GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. Declaration Certificate must be attached mandatorily
The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason what so ever
The time stipulated for Providing Service is 12 Months
Tender invited only for eligible contractors registered under Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act, 1970 with Karnataka Labour Department
Bidder should upload Domicile Certificate
Bidder should be locally based or situated within the nearest of the concerned office within Udupi District

The tenderer shall furnish required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the e procurement portal. The Original Formats/Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Bid for physical verification
The Successful Tenderer shall have to be submit 5% of Security Deposit on accepted tender amount in the form Bank Guarantee or FDR in the name of Executive Engineer PWD Division Udupi

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3. If Successful Bidder not made Agreement with Employer then the EMD Amount will be forfeited and Tender will Rejected

The person deployed by the contractor should not be below 18 years of age. Employment of child labour will lead to termination of the contract. The contractor should engage only such personnel, whose attendance have been thoroughly verified, including character and police verification and other formalities. The contractor shall be fully responsible for the conduct of the personnel deployed by them

For better management and smooth services, a register named the Man source services Complaint Register shall be maintained by the contractor for recording the complaints from the client officials through the inspection of the site, material on site, attendance sheet of the personnel, weekly report, client letter/ fax/e-mail, verbal complaints etc. The contractor should take necessary corrective action on any such complaints on priority basis

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity equal to (AxNx2.5 - B) A equal to Maximum value of Man power Supply service executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. 1 Year where B equal to Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on going works to be completed during the next 1 Year form the probable date of Award of this contract

The estimated rates are inclusive of EPF, ESI, labourcess, Service Charges, mobilization resources vz. labour, finance, livelihood and any other statutory deductions. The Bidder should pay the Monthly salary to the Outsource Employees on or before 5th of every month without any interest
The Bidder Should Submit Outsource Employees Bank /EPF/ESI Details with valid documents and deduction of the same should be submitted on every month

If the contractor is Stopping of Supplying of Services without any notice during the contract period or if there is a problem with the contract, the security deposit will be forfeited and a necessary action will be taken. The damage caused by the Service will be recovered from the Man Power Service Provider
Bidder should Be literate and should be conversant with the local languages

The Man Power Service Provider should provide all amenities to his personnel such as Identity card/badges etc., Man Power Service Provider should also take care of all safety and risk management of the personnel deployed during the period of contract

The staff is the employee of the Man Power Service Provider and not of the Government Department. The Government Department shall at no time directly or indirectly employ the Man Power Service Provider staff for the services of any other nature or deal with any personnel in any capacity during the tenure of this contract
The Man Power Service Provider should maintain muster roll of its employees

The Man Power Service Provider shall regularly remit the EPF& ESI (both employers and employees contribution) and Labor cess contribution to Government as per existing rules and shall pay all the legitimate statutory and mandatory remittances to the concerned respective departments and produce the copy of the paid challans once in every 3 months (quarterly) and failing which payment for the succeeding months will be withheld by the Department
The Man Power Service Provider shall produce the copies of the Service tax remittances made and quarterly Returns

In case of accidents/problems encountered by the employees while performing duty at department office and in relation to it then the compensation must be paid in accordance with the Worksman Compensation Act by the SERVICE PROVIDER/CONDUCTOR himself

The Contractor shall maintain proper and detailed record for the job carried out by their employees and shall also maintain all records and returns as necessary Labour Act, Minimum Wages Act, ESI Act, PF Act, etc, as relevant and applicable from time to time

The Contractor should provide Adhar Card/PF A/c number, ESI Card and Photo Identity card to the contract employees posted at PWD. This should be done immediately but not later than 7 days from the date of signing joint agreement

The contractor should employ only registered labours/Gangmans as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009. As per EPF & MP act 1952 in respect of the employees engaged by or through contractors, agencies and contractors shall have provident fund code no. & all the contract employees deployed by them are enrolled as members of provident fund
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
Tenderer should be Registered in Karnataka Labour Department and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer
The Bidder, at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site.The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense
The successful bidder has to follow the Government circular No. PWD/995/ IFA Dated:24/05/2024

In the case of the death of the contract or after executing the agreement /commencement of the work,his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
The contractor should be responsible for all deduction of the labours wages as per the Labour Act. The Public Works Department will not be held responsible for the same
Minimum Fuel allowance of Rs.2118.64 shall be paid per month per person excluding all applicable taxes, irrespective of quoted rate against fuel allowance.
Minimum wages shall be paid as per notification No:KAE 83 LWA 2022 dated 13.01.2023 minimum wages and VDA effect from 1.04.2026 to 31.03.2027 irrespective of quoted rate against monthly wages
The successful bidder has to follow the Government circular No. PWD/995/IFA Dated:24/05/202

The Tenderer should submit the scanned copy of the last 5years balance sheet indicating contract receipts duly certified and to submit the balance sheet indicating the contract receipts certified by the chartered accountant with UDIN No/Auditor & Tax consultant with their registration no as per the IT guide lines who ever is applicable the Contractors should have Registration of GST

Asper Karnataka state Government orderLD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated27.07.2007,a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund and Contractors should Follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Attach GST Declaration certificate in prescribed format
Past Five year i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 average- Rs.9.50 lakhs turn over required - attach annual turn over certificate along with profit and loss statement from CA.
The bidder should be eligible contractors registered Class IV and above PWD contractor and registered under Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act, 1970 with Karnataka Labour Department.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 satisfactorily completed as prime Man Power Service Provider , at least one similar Services such as - SUPPLY OF MAN POWER/ Mazdoor for Gangmans not less than 5 Mazdoor per month/60 Mazdoor per annum.
